messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the precise current local time in New York City right now.  

New York observes **Eastern Standard Time** (EST) when daylight saving isn’t active (UTC−5), and switches to **Eastern Daylight Time** (EDT) during daylight savings (UTC−4). If you need an accurate timestamp, check your phone’s world‑clock feature, a reliable online time service, or simply look at the clock on your device set to “America/New_York.”
